description: A shell script for creating or deleting a Kubernetes (k8s) kind cluster, including provider detection, argument parsing, prerequisite checks, and cluster management commands.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Prints informational messages in blue color.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Prints success messages in green color.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints warning messages in yellow color.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints error messages in red color and exits.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help information about script usage and options.

methods.name: provider_installed
methods.description: Checks if a container engine command (docker or podman) is installed.

methods.name: provider_responsive
methods.description: Checks if the container engine responds (docker info or podman info).

methods.name: detect_provider
methods.description: Detects whether docker or podman is installed and responsive.
